linkedin_post: TRI’s TR7600 SV launch is a useful signal for SMT teams: AXI throughput is no longer only a machine-speed question. The real value is whether faster 3D X-ray inspection can cover BGAs, THT and SiP without creating review bottlenecks — and whether the results connect back to MES, SPI, AOI and process-control data. What is the biggest AXI constraint on your line today: scan time, programming, review load, or data integration? #SMT #AXI #ElectronicsManufacturing #QualityEngineering
forum_answer:
Engineering takeaways:
- Validate the 20% throughput claim against your own board mix and sampling plan.
- Check defect coverage by package family: BGA, THT, SiP, BTC/QFN.
- Measure review time and false calls, not only scan speed.
- Confirm MES/CFX/Hermes integration if AXI data is needed for traceability.
- Use AXI results for upstream root-cause work, not just board disposition.
